blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.
blocks.zh: 循环变换器通过反复应用共享层来增加有效深度,提供了一种在不增加参数数的情况下进行规模计算的方法. 然而,全链路循环将上下文构建和迭代状态完善置于相同的经常性计算中,而没有明确区分它们的作用. 我们引入了非对称循环变换器(AsymLoop),它将单通道上下文编码与经常性状态改进区分开来. 单通因果编码器产生层特异性的全球密钥值(KV)缓存,在迭代之间仍保持固定,而重磅的经常性解码器则从其演化状态生成Local KV. 在一个单一软马克斯下共同关注这两个来源,使每次更新都能够将持久的背景信息与当前的中间状态相结合. 对于训练,我们对编码器和解码器采用重尾导层式学习率法. FineWeb-Edu的实验跨越了从60M到1B的4个模型尺度,在有效深度和培训符号预算的匹配下,比Full Loop的验证难度和下游平均精度持续较低。 在1B,AsymLoop改进了7个常识推理基准的平均零射精度,从49.58%提高到50.85%. 进一步的实验将这些好处扩大到较长的培训预算、OLMO式的主干线和稀少的专家混合模型。 这些结果支持非对称背景编码和状态完善,作为经常语言模型的有效设计.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scaling language models typically involves increasing parameters, training data, and computation together ( Henighan et al., 2020 ) . Looped Transformers offer another dimension for scaling computation: repeatedly applying a shared block increases effective depth without assigning independent parameters to every executed layer ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Lan et al., 2020 ) . Recent work further demonstrates that recurrent depth can improve reasoning performance through additional computation at test time ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) . This opportunity makes the organization of recurrence a central design concern. Performance depends not only on how many iterations a model executes, but also on which computations it repeats and how contextual information remains available across iterations.
blocks.zh: 扩大语言模型通常涉及增加参数、培训数据和共同计算(Henighan等人,2020年)。 循环变换器为缩放计算提供了另一个维度: 反复应用共享块会增加有效深度,而不给每个执行层分配独立参数(Dehghani等人,2019年;Lan等人,2020年). 最近的工作进一步表明,通过在试验时间进行额外计算,经常性深度可以提高推理性能(Geiping等人,2025年)。 这一机会使得组织复发成为中心设计问题. 性能不仅取决于一个模型执行的迭代次数,还取决于它重复的计算以及在整个迭代中如何保留背景信息.

blocks.en: Recurrence can be organized through different layer topologies, depending on which layers are repeated and which non-recurrent layers precede or follow them ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . A straightforward choice is to loop the entire Transformer stack, feeding the output of each pass back into the same stack for the next ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; we refer to this topology as Full Loop . However, analyses of pretrained language models suggest that different depths support distinct computational roles, including contextualizing input tokens, refining features, and forming predictions ( Lad et al., 2025 ) . Repeating the entire stack places these roles together within the recurrent computation, without explicitly separating input processing from iterative refinement. Analyses of looped models likewise observe multiple feedforward-like processing stages recurring within each iteration ( Blayney et al., 2026 ) . These findings motivate organizing recurrence around a division of roles: distinguishing context construction that can be performed once from state refinement to which additional computation can be allocated.
blocks.zh: 重复可以通过不同的地层地形来组织,取决于是哪个地层重复出现,哪个非经常性地层在它们之前或之后出现(Huang等人,2026年). 一个直截了当的选择是将整个变形器堆栈循环起来,将每个传递的输出反馈回下一个堆栈(Zhu等人,2025年);我们把这个地形称为全循环. 然而,对经过预先培训的语言模型的分析表明,不同的深度支持不同的计算作用,包括将输入符放在上下文、精炼特征和形成预测(Lad等人,2025年)。 重复整个堆栈将这些角色放在反复计算中,而没有明确地将输入处理与迭代改进区分开来. 对循环模型的分析同样也观察到每个迭代中反复出现的多个向导式处理阶段(Blayney等人,2026年)。 这些结论促使围绕角色的划分来组织重现:区分一次可以进行的上下文构建与可分配额外计算的国家完善。

blocks.en: Partial looping has been explored in recurrent language models, repeating only a selected subset of layers while executing the remaining layers once ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Controlled comparisons with matched parameter counts, effective depth, and training budgets report improvements over full-stack looping on several multi-step reasoning benchmarks ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Such designs make the distinction between recurrent and non-recurrent computation explicit, but choosing the scope of recurrence alone does not determine how the two components should work together. We argue that their different computational roles should guide a broader asymmetric design : non-recurrent layers can specialize in context construction, while recurrent layers perform iterative state updates, with information exchange connecting these two types of computation.
blocks.zh: 在经常语言模型中探索了部分循环,只重复一个选定的子集层,同时一次执行剩下的层(Geiping等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年). 与匹配参数数、有效深度和培训预算进行控制比较后,报告在几个多步骤推理基准的全链路循环方面有所改善(Huang等人,2026年)。 此类设计明确区分经常性和非经常性计算,但仅选择重现范围并不能决定两个组成部分应如何合作。 我们主张,它们不同的计算作用应该指导更广泛的不对称设计:非经常性层可以专门进行上下文构造,而经常性层则进行迭代状态更新,信息交换连接这两种类型的计算.

blocks.en: We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop) , which connects a single-pass causal encoder to a weight-tied recurrent decoder through joint attention to fixed Global KV and evolving Local KV. A causal encoder runs once and projects its output into per-decoder-layer Global key–value (KV) caches. These caches serve as contextual anchors that remain fixed across all iterations of a forward pass. A weight-tied decoder generates Local KV from its current hidden states at each iteration. The two sources offer complementary views: Global KV preserves access to the context encoded by the encoder, while Local KV reflects the decoder’s current intermediate state. Queries allocate attention jointly across both sources under a single softmax, enabling each update to integrate global contextual information with the current local state. All components are trained end to end.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了非对称循环变形器(AsymLoop),它通过共同关注固定全球KV和不断发展的本地KV,将一个单路因子编码器与一个量子化的经常性解码器连接起来. 一个因果编码器运行一次并预测其输出为每解码器层 Global 键 - 值(KV)缓存 。 这些缓存作为背景锚点,在前方通行证的所有迭代中保持固定。 加权刻度解码器从当前每个迭代的隐藏状态生成本地 KV 。 这两种来源提供了补充意见: Global KV保留对编码器编码的上下文的访问,而Local KV则反映了解码器目前的中间状态. 查询在一个单一软马克斯下将注意力联合分配给两个来源,使每个更新都能够将全球背景信息与当前本地状态整合. 所有部件都经过训练后结束。

blocks.en: For optimization, we adopt the heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method of He et al. (2026) for the encoder and decoder. The same spectral allocation rule is applied to matrices in both components. Encoder–decoder learning-rate differences arise from their measured spectral statistics. We use Asymmetric Learning Rate Schedule (ALRS) as a shorthand for this training configuration and examine the resulting allocation patterns and their empirical effects in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 为了优化,我们采用了He等人(2026年)的重尾导层学习率法,用于编码器和解码器. 这两种成分的矩阵都适用同样的光谱分配规则。 编码器–解码器的学习-速率差异源于其测量的光谱统计. 我们使用非对称学习率表(ALRS)作为这种培训配置的简称,并审查由此产生的分配模式及其在我们实验中的经验效应。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • An asymmetric recurrent architecture. We jointly design one-time context encoding and weight-tied recurrent updates, connecting them through joint attention to fixed Global KV and dynamic Local KV. • Analysis of context access under recurrence. Through component ablations and comparisons across recurrent depths, we examine the roles of fixed Global KV and evolving Local KV in recurrent state refinement. • Performance gains across model sizes. Across four model sizes, AsymLoop achieves lower validation perplexity and higher average zero-shot accuracy than Full Loop under matched training budgets and effective depth. Perplexity improves by 0.98 and 0.30 at 135M and 350M, respectively, while the seven-task average accuracy at 1B rises from 49.58% to 50.85%.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献是: 一个不对称的经常性建筑. 我们联合设计了一次性的上下文编码和量子化的经常性更新,通过共同关注固定全球KV和动态本地KV来连接它们. • 分析复发情况下的上下文访问。 通过对反复出现的深度进行分解和比较,我们审查了固定全球KV和不断演变的本地KV在经常性状态改进中的作用。 • 模型规模的业绩收益。 在四个模型大小上,AsymLoop在匹配的培训预算和有效深度下比FullLoop实现较低的验证偏差和更高的平均零射精度. 135M和350M的复杂度分别提高了0.98和0.30,而1B的七任务平均精度从49.58%上升到50.85%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Looped Transformers and Recurrent Depth. Weight-tied recurrence in Transformers traces back to Universal Transformers ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) and ALBERT ( Lan et al., 2020 ) , which established that parameter sharing across layers can achieve competitive linguistic representations. Theoretical investigations have formalized looped Transformers as programmable computers ( Giannou et al., 2023 ) capable of learning complex in-context algorithms ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and latent thoughts ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ) . More recently, scaling up test-time compute through recurrent depth has emerged as a promising alternative to chain-of-thought token generation ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) . Studies such as Parcae ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) and FLT ( Fu et al., 2026 ) explore stability in looped models. Beyond full-stack recurrence, partial-loop architectures already separate recurrent computation from non-recurrent input and output processing ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) . Our focus is the information exchange between these components: AsymLoop provides the recurrent decoder with layer-specific Global KV from a single-pass encoder, jointly accessed with evolving Local KV at every iteration.
blocks.zh: 循环变形器和经常深度。 变形金刚体中的重迭可以追溯到通用变形金刚体(Dehghani等人,2019年)和ALBERT(Lan等人,2020年),它们确定跨层共享参数可以实现竞争性语言表达. 理论调查正式将变形器作为可编程的计算机(Giannou等人,2023年),能够学习复杂的内文字算法(Yang等人,2024年)和潜伏的思想(Saunshi等人,2025年). 最近,通过反复进行的深度计算扩大试验时间计算,已成为一种有希望的替代思维链符号生成方法(Geiping等人,2025年)。 Parcae(Prairie等人,2026年)和FLT(Fu等人,2026年)等研究探索了循环模型中的稳定性. 除了全层重现外,部分滚动结构已经将经常性计算与非经常性投入和产出处理分开(Geiping等人,2025年)。 我们的重点是这些部门之间的信息交流: AsymLoop从一个单路编码器中为经常性的解码器提供图层特异性Global KV,在每个迭代时与不断发展的本地KV共同访问.

blocks.en: Causal Encoder-Decoder Architectures. Standard autoregressive language modeling typically employs decoder-only stacks. YOCO lets upper layers reuse KV produced by lower causal layers ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . The Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) proposed in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) divides the Transformer into an encoder that generates a static Global KV cache once, and a decoder that attends to this cache alongside standard causal dependencies. While CED demonstrated KV cache savings during inference, it was conceived as a non-recurrent ( K = 1 K=1 ) feedforward model. Their asymmetry also suggests a way to organize recurrent language models: build a causal representation of the input once, then let a recurrent stack iteratively refine its state while retaining access to that representation.
blocks.zh: Causal Encoder-Decoder 建筑公司. 标准自递式语言建模一般只使用解码器堆栈. YOCO允许上层再利用由下层因果层产生的KV(Sun等人,2024年). 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年)中提出的Causal Encoder-Decoder(CED)将变形器分割成一个一次生成静态Global KV缓存的编码器,以及一个与标准因果关系并列的缓存的解码器. 虽然CED在推论中演示了KV缓存节省,但它被设想为一种非经常性(K=1K=1)的feedforward模型. 它们的不对称性也建议一种方法来组织经常性语言模型:一次建立输入的因果表示,然后让一个经常性的堆栈反复地细化其状态,同时保留对这个表示的获取.

blocks.en: Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization and Layerwise Optimization. Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) characterizes weight spectra through fitted power-law tails ( Martin and Mahoney, 2021 ; Martin et al., 2021 ) . He et al. (2026) use these spectral exponents to allocate learning rates across layers and modules. We apply their allocation rule to the non-recurrent encoder and the weight-tied decoder. Encoder parameters are used once per forward pass, whereas decoder parameters are reused across iterations and accumulate gradient contributions from each use. This difference motivates allowing their learning rates to vary.
blocks.zh: 重轨自律与图层优化. 重轨自规范化(HT-SR)通过装配的动力法尾巴来描述重量光谱(Martin和Mahoney,2021年;Martin等人,2021年). 他等人(2026年)利用这些光谱指数来分层和模块的学习率. 我们对非经常性编码器和重力编解码器适用它们的分配规则. 编码器参数每前传一次使用,而解码器参数则在迭代之间重复使用,并积累每次使用的梯度贡献. 这种差异促使他们的学习率有所不同。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate AsymLoop on LLaMA-style architectures at the 60M, 135M, 350M, and 1B scales following He et al. (2026) . Section 4.1 defines the baselines, training budgets, and effective-depth comparisons, with full configurations and hardware details in Appendix A . We then report pre-training results across model sizes (Section 4.2 ), downstream performance (Section 4.3 ), the effect of recurrent depth (Section 4.4 ), ablation studies (Section 4.5 ), and transfer to an OLMo-style backbone (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价AsymLoop的LLaMA风格建筑, 第4.1节界定了基线、培训预算和有效深入的比较,附录A中的完整配置和硬件细节。 然后,我们报告跨模型规模(第4.2节)、下游业绩(第4.3节)、重复深度的影响(第4.4节)、开发研究(第4.5节)和转入OLMo型骨干(附录G)的培训前结果。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Pre-training. All model families in the main experiments use the LLaMA-style backbone configurations following He et al. (2026) and are trained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) . To study the scaling behavior of AsymLoop, we evaluate the 60M, 135M, 350M, and 1B configurations. Training token budgets follow the Chinchilla scaling law ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , which prescribes approximately 20 20 training tokens per parameter, giving 1.68B, 3B, 7B, and 20B tokens at the four model sizes. Detailed data splits, model configurations, and training budgets are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 预训. 主要实验中的所有模范家庭都采用了继He等人(2026年)之后的LLAMA风格骨干配置,并从头开始在FineWeb-Edu(Penedo等人,2024年)上进行训练. 为了研究AsymLoop的缩放行为,我们评价了60M,135M,350M和1B配置. 训练符号预算遵循钦奇拉缩放法(Hoffmann等人,2022年),规定每个参数约20个训练符号,给出1.68B,3B,7B,和20B四个模型尺寸的标志. 详细数据划分、模型配置和培训预算载于附录A。

blocks.en:
Baselines and depth matching. We compare AsymLoop with two vanilla baselines: a standard non-recurrent Transformer ( Dense ), and a homogeneous looped Transformer that repeats the entire Transformer stack with weights shared across iterations ( Full Loop ). We compare recurrent models at matched effective depth, defined as the total number of Transformer layers executed per forward pass.
The additional parameters and computation introduced by Global KV are detailed in Appendix D .

基线和深度匹配。 我们比较了AsymLoop和两个香草基线:一个标准的非经常性变形器(Dense),和一个同质的循环变形器,它重复了整个变形器堆栈,各迭代共用重量(Full Loop). 我们比较了相应的有效深度的经常模型,定义为每个前传执行的变压器层的总数.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We report validation cross-entropy and perplexity on held-out FineWeb-Edu data to assess language modeling performance. We further evaluate the pretrained models on seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks under zero-shot and five-shot settings: PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) , Social IQa ( Sap et al., 2019 ) , HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) , WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2021 ) , ARC-Challenge (ARC-c) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , ARC-Easy (ARC-e) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , and OpenBookQA (OBQA) ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) . We use the standard prompts from the LM Evaluation Harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) and report per-task accuracy and the unweighted mean across tasks. Evaluation settings are summarized in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.2 Pre-training under the Chinchilla Scaling Law
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 《钦奇拉扩展法》规定的预培训

blocks.en: To examine the scalability of AsymLoop, we jointly increase model size and training token budget following the Chinchilla scaling law. Figure 2 (a, b) shows that AsymLoop consistently achieves lower validation loss than Dense and Full Loop across all four scales, from 60M to 1B. Its advantage over Full Loop is maintained at matched effective depth and training budgets within each scale. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of AsymLoop across model sizes, with sustained improvements at the billion-parameter scale. These gains also extend to an OLMo-style backbone ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) , where AsymLoop reduces validation perplexity by 14.8% relative to the depth-matched Full Loop (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 为了审查AsymLoop的可扩展性,我们共同根据钦奇拉缩放法增加了模型规模和培训符号预算. 图2(a,b)显示,AsymLoop在所有四个尺度(从60M到1B)的验证损失始终低于Dense和Full Loop。 它相对于 " 全循环 " 的优势保持在每个比额表内相应的有效深度和培训预算。 这些结果显示了AsymLoop跨模型大小的有效性,在10亿参数尺度上持续改进. 这些收益还扩展到OLMo风格的骨干(Groeneveld等人,2024年),AsymLoop将验证难度比深度匹配的全循环(附录G)降低14.8%.

blocks.en: AsymLoop consistently improves both language-modeling loss and zero-shot downstream accuracy over Full Loop across all evaluated scales. Notably, the downstream advantage grows monotonically with model scale, from 0.13 percentage points at 60M to 1.27 points at 1B. We examine the task-level results in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: AsymLoop在所有评价尺度的Full Loop上不断提高语言模型损失和下游零射精度。 值得注意的是,下游的优势与模型尺度单调增长,从60M的0.13个百分点增加到1B的1.27个百分点. 我们在第4.3节审查了任务一级的结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Downstream Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 下游评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the pretrained models on seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks to assess their downstream generalization: PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) , Social IQa ( Sap et al., 2019 ) , HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) , WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2021 ) , ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , ARC-Easy ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , and OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) . Evaluations cover all four model sizes under both zero-shot and five-shot settings, using the standard prompts provided by the LM Evaluation Harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) . Table 1 summarizes the per-task and average accuracies.
blocks.zh: 我们用七个常识推理基准来评估预先训练过的模型, PIQA(Bisk等人,2020年),社会 IQa(Sap等人,2019年),HelaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年),WinoGrande (坂口等,2021年),ARC-Challenge (克拉克等人,2018年),ARC-Easy (克拉克等人,2018年),和OpenBookQA (米哈伊洛夫等人,2018年). 利用LM评价Harness提供的标准提示(Gao等人,2024年),在零镜头和五镜头设置下,评价涵盖所有四个模型大小. 表1汇总了每项任务和平均工作量。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , AsymLoop consistently outperforms Dense and Full Loop in average accuracy across all four model sizes under both zero-shot and five-shot settings. The improvements extend across multiple benchmarks, with particularly broad gains in five-shot evaluation: AsymLoop achieves the best performance on all seven tasks at 350M and six of the seven tasks at 1B. At 350M, its average accuracy exceeds Full Loop by 2.15 percentage points. These results demonstrate that the pre-training gains of AsymLoop translate into stronger downstream commonsense reasoning across both evaluation settings. We further analyze the training dynamics of downstream performance at the 1B scale in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,AsymLoop在零射和五射两种设置下,在所有四个模型大小中均以平均精度超过Dense和Full Loop。 改进涉及多个基准,在五轮评估中取得了特别广泛的成果: AsymLoop在350M实现所有7项任务的最佳表现,在1B实现7项任务中的6项. 在350M时,其平均精度超过全循环2.15个百分点. 这些结果表明,AsymLoop的培训前成果转化为在两个评价环境中更强有力的下游常识推理。 我们进一步分析了附录F中1B级下游业绩的培训动态。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we evaluate the mathematical reasoning performance of the 1B pretrained models through supervised fine-tuning on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) . AsymLoop achieves an accuracy of 11.75%, a 1.52 percentage point improvement over Full Loop. These results suggest that its downstream benefits also extend to supervised fine-tuning; detailed results and training settings are provided in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 此外,我们通过对GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)的监督微调,评估1B预训模型的数学推理性能。 AsymLoop的精度达到11.75%,比FullLoop提高1.52个百分点. 这些结果表明,它的下游效益也扩大到监督的微调;附录H提供了详细的成果和培训环境。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Downstream Performance under a 5 × 5\times Chinchilla Budget
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 下游5×5下的业绩 钦奇利亚预算

blocks.en: To investigate whether the benefits of AsymLoop persist under extended training, we increase the training budget of the 350M models from 7B to 35B tokens, corresponding to five times the Chinchilla budget. We compare AsymLoop with Dense and Full Loop under the same token budget, maintaining matched effective depth between the recurrent models. Table 2 presents their zero-shot and five-shot performance on the seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了调查AsymLoop的好处在扩展培训下是否继续存在,我们把350M模式的培训预算从7B增加到35B代币,相当于钦奇拉预算的5倍. 我们在同样的预算下将AsymLoop与Dense和FullLoop进行比较,在经常模式之间保持相应的有效深度。 表2列出了他们在7个常识推理基准上的零射和5射性能.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , AsymLoop maintains the highest average accuracy in both zero-shot and five-shot evaluation under the extended training budget. In five-shot evaluation, it matches or surpasses both baselines on all seven tasks, improving average accuracy over Full Loop from 46.67% to 47.41%. These results demonstrate that the downstream benefits of AsymLoop persist with a fivefold increase in training tokens, supporting its effectiveness under extended pre-training.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,AsymLoop在扩大的培训预算下,在零射和五射评价中均保持最高平均准确度。 在五拍评价中,它在所有七项任务上都匹配或超过两个基线,使全环的平均准确度从46.67%提高到47.41%。 这些结果表明,AsymLoop的下游利益继续存在,培训标志增加了五倍,支持了在扩大的预培训中的有效性。

To compare architectures at matched effective depth, these configurations are paired with Dense, Full Loop with K = 2 K=2 , and Full Loop with K = 3 K=3 , respectively, yielding depths of L L , 2 ​ L 2L , and 3 ​ L 3L . The training token budget is held fixed within each model scale. Table 3 reports validation perplexity for these comparisons.

Its advantage is already evident at K = 1 K=1 and persists as effective depth increases to 2 ​ L 2L and 3 ​ L 3L . Increasing the number of decoder iterations further reduces perplexity across the 60M, 135M, and 350M scales. For example, at 350M, perplexity decreases from 12.20 at K = 1 K=1 to 11.92 at K = 5 K=5 . These results demonstrate that AsymLoop remains effective across different depths and benefits from additional recurrent computation.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies and Analysis

blocks.en: We examine the contributions of AsymLoop’s architectural and optimization components. Further analyses of asymmetric learning-rate allocation, Global KV under recurrence, and alternative context-access designs are provided in Appendices B and C .

Under uniform learning rates, removing either Global KV or Local KV increases validation perplexity at both K = 3 K=3 and K = 5 K=5 (Table 4 a), indicating that encoder context and evolving decoder states provide complementary information. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented AsymLoop, an asymmetric looped Transformer that combines single-pass context encoding with recurrent state refinement through joint attention to Global and Local KV. We train this architecture using the spectral layerwise learning-rate method of He et al. (2026) and evaluate its effect through optimization ablations. Across four model scales from 60M to 1B, AsymLoop achieves lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than the depth-matched Full Loop baseline. Its language-modeling gains extend to an OLMo-style backbone and sparse MoE feed-forward layers, while supervised fine-tuning on GSM8K also yields higher mathematical reasoning accuracy. Although AsymLoop requires more training FLOPs than the original Full Loop, it achieves lower validation loss than a widened Full Loop baseline under matched training FLOPs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了AsymLoop,一种不对称的环绕变形器,通过共同关注全球和地方KV,将单通道上下文编码与经常性状态完善结合起来. 我们使用He等人(2026年)的光谱分层学习率方法来训练这一架构,并通过优化调制来评价其效果. 在60M到1B的4个模型尺度中,AsymLoop比深度匹配的全循环基线实现更低的验证偏差和更高的下游平均精度. 其语言建模收益扩展到OLMo风格的骨干和稀疏的MOE feed-forward层,而监督的GSM8K的微调也提高了数学推理精度. 虽然AsymLoop需要比原Full Loop更多的训练FLOP,但它在匹配训练FLOP下比拓宽的Full Loop基线实现较低的验证损失.

blocks.en: Following the allocation and scheduling procedure of He et al. (2026) , ALRS assigns matrix-wise learning-rate multipliers in [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] . blocks.en: D.2 Compute–Performance Trade-offs Across Recurrent Depths
blocks.zh: D.2 计算 - 经常性深度的绩效权衡

Figure 5 compares average zero-shot accuracy against analytical training FLOPs, pairing AsymLoop with Dense or Full Loop at matched effective depths of L L , 2 ​ L 2L , and 3 ​ L 3L .
blocks.zh: 我们调查在模型尺度和反复出现深度的训练计算和下游业绩之间的权衡。 图5比较了分析培训FLOP的平均零射精度,将AsymLoop与Dense或Full Loop在LL、2L 2L和3L 3L的对应有效深度进行配对。

blocks.en: Across all three depth settings, AsymLoop consistently achieves higher accuracy than its depth-matched baseline with a modest increase in training compute. Comparing across depths further reveals a favorable compute–performance trade-off: at 60M, 135M, and 350M, AsymLoop with K = 1 K=1 achieves higher accuracy than Full Loop with either K = 2 K=2 or K = 3 K=3 , while requiring fewer training FLOPs. These results show that AsymLoop can offer both better downstream performance and lower compute than deeper Full Loop configurations. Complementary comparisons with a widened Full Loop baseline at matched analytical per-step training FLOPs are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 在所有三种深度设置中,AsymLoop的精确度始终高于其深度匹配基线,培训计算略有增加。 跨深度比较进一步揭示出一个有利的计算-性能权衡:在60M,135M,350M时,与K=1K=1的AsymLoop的精度高于与K=2K=2或K=3K=3的Full Loop,同时要求更少的FLOP培训. 这些结果显示,AsymLoop既能提供更好的下游性能,又能比更深的全循环配置更低的计算. 附录E提供了与扩大的全环基线的补充比较,对应的每步分析培训FLOP。

blocks.en: Appendix E Performance at Matched Per-Step Training FLOPs
blocks.zh: 附录E 在每个阶段进行匹配培训的绩效

blocks.en: To investigate whether AsymLoop’s performance gains arise solely from additional training FLOPs, we compare it with a widened Full Loop baseline. We increase the baseline’s SwiGLU intermediate dimension while preserving its recurrent architecture, matching AsymLoop’s analytical per-step training FLOPs under a full-block recomputation assumption.
blocks.zh: 为了调查AsymLoop的绩效收益是否完全来自额外的培训FLOP,我们把它与扩大的全环基线进行比较。 我们增加基线的SwiGLU中间维度,同时保留其经常性架构,将AsymLoop的每步分析训练FLOP与全块重算假设相匹配.

blocks.en: E.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: E.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate the original Full Loop, widened Full Loop, and AsymLoop at the 60M and 135M scales. At both scales, the widened baseline increases the FFN dimension from 2048 to 2656. Full Loop uses two iterations, while AsymLoop uses three decoder iterations with ALRS. Within each scale, all models share the training data, token budget, batch size, and distributed training configuration. At 60M, we report validation cross-entropy from one run per configuration; at 135M, we report the mean and sample standard deviation over three training seeds per configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们以60M和135M的尺度评估原全环,拓宽全环,以及AsymLoop. 在这两个尺度上,扩大的基线将FFN维度从2048提高到2656. 全循环使用两个迭代,而AsymLoop则使用三个与ALRS的解码器迭代. 在每一尺度内,所有模型都分享培训数据、象征性预算、批量规模和分布式培训配置。 60M时,我们报告每个配置一次的验证交叉;135M时,我们报告每个配置三次训练种子的平均和抽样标准差。

blocks.en: E.2 Results
blocks.zh: E.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 10 shows that widening Full Loop improves validation cross-entropy, closing approximately 40% of its gap to AsymLoop at both model scales. Nevertheless, AsymLoop achieves the lowest cross-entropy in both comparisons. Its advantage also persists across all three random seeds in the 135M experiments. These results suggest that additional training FLOPs alone do not explain AsymLoop’s performance gains.
blocks.zh: 表10显示,在两个模型尺度上,扩大全环可改进交叉式验证,缩小大约40%的AsymLoop缺口。 尽管如此,AsymLoop在这两种比较中都实现了最低的交叉切入. 在135M实验中,它在所有三个随机种子中也一直保持优势. 这些结果表明,仅靠额外的培训FLOP并不能解释AsymLoop的业绩收益。

blocks.en: At 135M, each configuration is evaluated over three training seeds. The widened Full Loop and AsymLoop achieve validation cross-entropies of 2.78983 ± 0.00197 2.78983\pm 0.00197 and 2.74947 ± 0.00299 2.74947\pm 0.00299 , respectively (mean ± \pm sample standard deviation). The mean difference is 0.04036 0.04036 , and all three AsymLoop runs achieve lower cross-entropy than all three widened Full Loop runs. These observations support the consistency of the improvement within the evaluated training configuration.
blocks.zh: 在135M时,每个配置都通过三个培训种子进行评估。 拓宽的全环和AsymLoop分别实现2.78983±0.00197 2.78983/pm 0.00197和2.74947±0.00299 2.74947/pm 0.00299的校验跨环(平均值±\pm样本标准差). 平均差为0.04036 0.04036,所有三项AsymLoop运行都实现了比所有三项拓宽的FullLoop运行更低的交叉内径. 这些意见支持在评价的培训配置中改进的一致性。

The 60M results are single runs; the 135M results are means ± \pm sample standard deviations over three training seeds. Step time and peak memory are measured on eight H100 GPUs. Darker/lighter blue marks the best/second-best cross-entropy at each model scale.

blocks.en: E.3 Training FLOPs Verification
blocks.zh: E.3 培训FLOPs 核查

blocks.en: We measure per-step training matrix FLOPs on H100 GPUs, including forward, backward, and activation recomputation. Table 11 shows that the widened Full Loop uses 1.23%–2.29% fewer FLOPs than AsymLoop, indicating closely matched training compute.
blocks.zh: 我们在H100GPU上测量每步训练矩阵FLOP,包括前向,后向,激活重算. 表11显示,加宽的全循环使用FLOP比AsymLoop少1.23%,表明训练计算非常匹配。

blocks.en: Table 11: Measured matrix FLOPs per training step. Counts include forward, backward, and activation recomputation, with sequence length 1024 and batch size 1.

blocks.en: E.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: E.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: AsymLoop achieves lower validation cross-entropy than the widened Full Loop at both model scales while using fewer parameters. Table 10 also shows comparable peak memory usage and per-step training times of the same order of magnitude. These results highlight AsymLoop’s performance advantage at closely matched training FLOPs.
blocks.zh: AsymLoop在使用较少参数的同时,在两个模型尺度上实现比拓宽的全循环(Full Loop)更低的验证跨内径. 表10还显示可比的峰值内存使用和每步训练时间,数量顺序相同. 这些结果凸显了AsymLoop在紧密匹配的FLOP培训中的表现优势.

blocks.en: Appendix F Downstream Training Dynamics at 1B
blocks.zh: 附录F 下游 1B级培训动态

blocks.en: We track the zero-shot performance of 1B Full Loop and AsymLoop throughout pre-training. Figure 6 presents the accuracy trajectories on seven downstream benchmarks and their average.
blocks.zh: 我们追踪1B全循环和AsymLoop在预训期间的零射性能. 图6列出了7个下游基准的准确轨迹及其平均值。

blocks.en: Both models improve with training, while AsymLoop develops a clearer advantage in average accuracy during the later stages. This trend is particularly evident on OpenBookQA, ARC-Easy, and HellaSwag, where AsymLoop maintains higher accuracy across successive evaluations toward the end of training.
blocks.zh: 这两种模型都随着培训而改进,而AsymLoop则在以后阶段的平均准确性有了更明确的优势。 在OpenBookQA、ARC-Easy和HelaSwag中,这一趋势尤其明显,在培训结束时,AsymLoop在一系列评价中保持更高的准确性。

blocks.zh: 图6 1B级预训期间下游表现. 7个基准的零射精度及其平均值. 紫色和黄色分别表示AsymLoop和FullLoop.

blocks.en: Appendix G Transfer to an OLMo-Style Backbone
blocks.zh: 附录 G 转到 OLMo- Style 背骨

blocks.en: To assess generalization across backbone architectures, we evaluate AsymLoop on an OLMo-style backbone ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) . We compare Dense, Full Loop, and AsymLoop trained from scratch.
blocks.zh: 为了评估整个主干结构的概况,我们用OLMo式主干评价AsymLoop(Groeneveld等人,2024年)。 我们比较了Dense, Full Loop 和AsymLoop 从头开始训练。

blocks.en: G.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: G.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All models use eight physical Transformer blocks with hidden dimension 512, eight attention heads, and SwiGLU intermediate dimension 2048, together with RMSNorm and RoPE. Full Loop repeats the backbone twice, while AsymLoop combines a four-layer encoder with a four-layer decoder repeated three times. The two looped models therefore have the same effective depth of 16.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都使用8个物理变形器块,带有隐藏的512,8个注意头,以及SwiGLU中间尺寸2048,连同RMSNorm和ROPE. 全循环重复骨干两次,而AsymLoop将四层编码器与四层解码器结合重复三次. 因此,两个循环模型的有效深度为16。

blocks.en: We train all models on approximately 1.68B tokens from FineWeb-Edu-dedup using the SmolLM tokenizer, with sequence length 1024 and global batch size 512. Validation cross-entropy and perplexity are evaluated on a shared held-out set.
blocks.zh: 我们在FineWeb-Edu-dedup的大约1.68B符号上使用SmolLM的标注器对所有模型进行训练,序列长度1024,全球批量尺寸512. 在一套共享的搁置装置上对交叉性与复杂性进行验证。

blocks.en: We use AdamW with a cosine learning-rate schedule and 10% warmup. AsymLoop applies ALRS multipliers in [ 1 , 3 ] [1,3] , with allocation updates restricted to the first 20% of training.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW 的余弦学习率表 和10%的热身。 AsymLoop在[1,3][1,3]中应用ALRS乘数,分配更新仅限于培训的前20%.

blocks.en: G.2 Validation Results
blocks.zh: G.2 审定结果

blocks.en: Table 12: Validation performance on an OLMo-style backbone. Cross-entropy and perplexity ( ↓ \downarrow ). Depth denotes effective depth. Darker/lighter blue marks the best/second-best results.
blocks.zh: 表12:OLMo风格骨干上的验证性能. 纵横交错(\\ downarrow ). 深度表示有效深度. 较暗/较浅的蓝色标记是最佳/次最佳结果.

blocks.en: Table 12 shows that AsymLoop achieves the lowest validation cross-entropy and perplexity among all three models. Compared with the depth-matched Full Loop, AsymLoop reduces perplexity by 14.8%. These results demonstrate that its language-modeling benefits extend to an OLMo-style backbone, supporting its applicability across backbone architectures.
blocks.zh: 表12显示,AsymLoop在所有三种模型中都实现了最低的验证跨直径和复杂度. 与深度匹配的全循环相比,AsymLoop将复杂度降低了14.8%. 这些结果表明,其语言模型化的好处扩展到OLMo式主干网,支持其适用于主干架构。

blocks.en: Appendix H Supervised Fine-Tuning on GSM8K
blocks.zh: 附录H 监督 GSM8K的微调

blocks.en: To evaluate mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning, we fine-tune the 1B pretrained models on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) . We compare Dense, Full Loop, and AsymLoop after three epochs of full-parameter adaptation.
blocks.zh: 为了在监督的微调后评价数学推理,我们对GSM8K上的1B预训模型进行了微调(Cobbe等人,2021年). 我们比较了Dense, Full Loop, 和AsymLoop 经过三个时代的全参数调整。

blocks.en: H.1 Results after Three SFT Epochs
blocks.zh: H.1 三个SFT之后的结果 埃波希斯语Name

blocks.en: Table 13: GSM8K accuracy of 1B models after three epochs of full-parameter supervised fine-tuning. The best result is highlighted in blue.
blocks.zh: 表13:1B型机车的GSM8K精度经过3个全参数监督微调后. 最佳结果以蓝色突出。

blocks.en: Table 13 shows that AsymLoop achieves the highest GSM8K accuracy among the three models. Under matched fine-tuning schedules, AsymLoop reaches 11.75% accuracy, improving over Full Loop by 1.52 percentage points. These results suggest that AsymLoop’s pre-training benefits also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表13显示AsymLoop在三种模型中实现了最高的GSM8K精度. 根据相应的微调时间表,AsymLoop的精度达到11.75%,比FullLoop提高1.52个百分点. 这些结果表明,AsymLoop的训练前好处也扩大到在经过监督的微调后进行数学推理。

blocks.en: H.2 Training and Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: H.2 训练和评价议定书

blocks.en: We fine-tune the 1B pretrained models using AdamW with a global batch size of 32, a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and cosine decay with 10% warmup. We report results after three epochs using a single random seed.
blocks.zh: 我们用 AdamW 来微调 1B 预先训练的模型 全球批量大小为 32, 峰值学习率为 10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 ), 和 余弦衰变 10% 的热量。 我们用单一的随机种子报告三个纪元后的结果。

blocks.en: We use 6,973 GSM8K training examples for supervised fine-tuning and reserve 500 for development, with a context length of 1024. Training supervises the worked solutions and final answers, excluding question and padding tokens from the loss.
blocks.zh: 我们使用6 973 GSM8K培训实例,进行有监督的微调并储备500个用于发展,背景长度为1024个。 培训监督行之有效的解决办法和最终答案,不包括问题和损失的装饰品。

blocks.en: We evaluate all 1,319 test questions using greedy decoding without demonstrations, allowing up to 512 generated tokens. Accuracy is computed by comparing the normalized final numerical answer with the reference.
blocks.zh: 我们用没有示威的贪婪解码来评估所有1,319个测试问题,允许多达512个生成的代币. 准确性是通过将最终数字答案与参考数字进行比较来计算的。

blocks.en: Appendix I Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Models
blocks.zh: 附录一 专家混合模型

blocks.en: We investigate whether AsymLoop’s benefits extend to sparse mixture-of-experts models ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . Using the 60M and 135M backbone configurations, we compare MoE variants of Dense, Full Loop, and AsymLoop, where Dense denotes the non-recurrent architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们调查AsymLoop的好处是否扩展到稀少的专家混合模型(Muennighoff等人,2025年)。 使用60M和135M骨干配置,我们比较了Dense,Full Loop和AsymLoop的MOE变体,其中Dense表示非经常性架构.

blocks.en: I.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: I.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We replace each feed-forward layer with eight SwiGLU experts and top-2 routing, without token dropping. Each expert has intermediate dimension 1024, preserving the active expert-matrix parameter count of the original dense FFN. Full Loop repeats the backbone twice, while AsymLoop divides it equally into an encoder and a decoder and repeats the decoder three times, matching the effective depth of Full Loop.
blocks.zh: 我们用8个SwiGLU专家 和前2位的路由 来取代每个向导层 而不降信号 每个专家都有中间尺寸1024,保留了原始密集FFN的主动专家-矩阵参数计数. 全环重复主干线两次,而AsymLoop将其平等分为编码器和解码器,并重复解码器三次,匹配全环的有效深度.

blocks.en: Experts and routers are shared across recurrences, with routing decisions recomputed at each iteration. Training combines cross-entropy with load-balancing and router z-loss terms weighted by 0.01 and 0.001, respectively. Validation cross-entropy excludes these auxiliary losses.
blocks.zh: 专家和路由器在反复出现时共享,路由决定在每个迭代重算. 训练结合了负载平衡和路由器 z 损失,分别加权0.01和0.001。 校验横切排除这些辅助损失.

blocks.en: We train all models on FineWeb-Edu-dedup using AdamW with a cosine learning-rate schedule, sequence length 1024, and global batch size 512. The 60M and 135M configurations use 1.6B and 3B training tokens, respectively. We report validation cross-entropy and perplexity on a shared held-out set.
blocks.zh: 我们在FineWeb-Edu-dedup上使用 AdamW 进行所有模型的训练,并配有余弦学习率表,序列长度1024,全球批量尺寸512. 60M和135M配置分别使用1.6B和3B训练符. 我们报告一个共享的组合的 交叉性 和复杂性。

blocks.en: I.2 Validation Results
blocks.zh: I.2 验证结果

blocks.en: Table 14: Validation performance of sparse MoE models. Cross-entropy and perplexity ( ↓ \downarrow ) with eight experts and top-2 routing. Darker/lighter blue marks the best/second-best results at each model scale.

Table 14 shows that AsymLoop achieves the lowest validation cross-entropy and perplexity at both model scales. At 135M, it reduces perplexity by 4.5% relative to the depth-matched Full Loop. These results show that AsymLoop remains effective with sparse experts, extending its applicability beyond dense feed-forward layers.
blocks.zh: 表14显示,AsymLoop在两个模型尺度上都实现了最低的验证跨直径和复杂度. 在135M时,相对于深度匹配的全循环,它会降低4.5%的复杂度. 这些结果显示,AsymLoop仍然对稀少的专家有效,将其适用范围扩大到密集的饲料向前层之外。
